name: edit
description: Replace exact literal oldText with newText in an existing file; not a regex or patch. Read first to obtain the actual text. Ambiguous matches fail unless replaceAll is true. Uses revision conflict detection; expectedRevision is an optional additional check.

path.description: VFS path: ~ is /home/user; relative paths use this agent's cwd. Paths are case-sensitive.

oldText.description: Exact existing substring, including whitespace/newlines. Include enough context for one match.

newText.description: Literal replacement text; empty string deletes oldText.

replaceAll.description: Replace every exact match; default false rejects multiple matches.

expectedRevision.description: For write, omitted or 0 means create only. To overwrite, read the file first and pass its returned revision here. After a conflict, read again; do not guess or reuse a stale revision. For edit, optional additional revision check.
